games.name: The Silent Ascent
games.desc:
Using only your grappling hook to traverse a realm of towering grey pillars, mysterious biomes, dangerous creatures, and strange inhabitants. 

- Every climb is different, each Ascent is randomly generated.
- Play solo, or bring your friends!
- Create a party to work together!
- Collect Essence to purchase hats and faces, and style your perfect climber.

Controls
Click / Right Trigger - Grapple
E / D-Pad Up - Reel In
Q / D-Pad Down - Reel Out
Jump (At Wall) - Climb
H / D-Pad Left - Call Out

The Silent Ascent launched on April 13th, 2026.
The game is currently in Beta.
This game is currently being worked on by one developer, I'm trying my best to keep updates consistent!
